# Templates and checklists

**Status: Draft — the validation protocol and SOP templates are available for editorial review. Other resources remain planned. None is approved for operational use.**

These reusable resources will support the [validation framework](../validation-framework/index.md) and [domain-specific protocols and SOPs](../protocols/index.md).

| Resource | Intended purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Validation protocol template](validation-protocol-template.md) — draft | Record the clinical problem, intended use and proposed validation plan. |
| [SOP template](sop-template.md) — draft | Describe one repeatable activity, its responsibilities, checks and records. |
| Data collection template | Describe the planned collection and documentation of samples and patient data; the public repository is not a destination for patient records. |
| Model evaluation checklist | Support documentation of computational/model evaluation where applicable. |
| Reporting template | Organise validation findings, limitations and translation considerations. |

Use the validation protocol template for the study plan and the SOP template for individual repeatable activities referenced by that plan.
